semantic_meaning: Traces the structural flow path (cyan) and highlights the control junction (amber) along the route.
when_to_use: To show how inputs become outputs through the system
To connect a claim to the chokepoint physically/structurally
To turn text claims into mechanism motion
when_not_to_use: As decorative motion in the background
If the route is unknown/unsupported by the story evidence
If the map is too dense to trace legibly

forbidden.red: Red is reserved for consequence/failure/exposure only.

animation_behavior.description: Route draws in cyan; at control junction the amber highlight pulses/locks; optional return flow fade.

input_parameters.name: junction_index
input_parameters.description: Index of the control junction point (amber pulse/lock).

state_beats.label: route_settle
state_beats.meaningful_change: Route dims to context; focus shifts to next device.

expected_outputs: A traced cyan route with an amber control junction emphasis
validation_notes: Cyan is structural flow only; do not use cyan as hero highlight beyond flow.
Amber is only for the control junction/chokepoint.
